title: The Killing
description: The organizers of a brilliantly conceived racetrack heist find their perfect crime beginning to unravel.

title: Slander
description: A scandal-sheet publisher (Steve Cochran) smears a TV performer (Van Johnson) who refuses to be blackmailed by his past.

title: American Graffiti
description: Four teens in 1962 California get a final, nostalgic glimpse of innocence before facing their post-graduation lives.

title: The Young Runaways
description: Three teens (Brooke Bundy, Kevin Coughlin, Patty McCormack) join other lost souls on the street in Chicago's hippie district.

title: Calling All Husbands
description: A henpecked husband (Ernest Truex) whose wife bemoans their marriage presents to her a past suitor (George Tobias), a crook on the lam.

title: Calling Philo Vance
description: The urbane detective (James Stephenson) ties a string of murders to spies seeking plans to a new bomber.

title: Calling Bulldog Drummond
description: The British sleuth (Walter Pidgeon) leaves retirement to help a Scotland Yard woman (Margaret Leighton) catch thieves armed with radar.

title: Slander
description: A scandal-sheet publisher (Steve Cochran) smears a TV performer (Van Johnson) who refuses to be blackmailed by his past.

title: Mame
description: Wiped out by the crash of '29, a woman (Lucille Ball) marries a Georgia millionaire (Robert Preston) and lives life to the fullest.

title: A Stolen Life
description: A New England artist (Bette Davis) takes the place and the husband (Glenn Ford) of her twin sister who has drowned.

title: The Clock
description: An office worker (Judy Garland) meets and marries a corporal (Robert Walker) on two-day leave in New York.

title: Citizen Kane
description: Enigmatic newspaper magnate Charles Foster Kane (Orson Welles) rises, falls and leaves behind a riddle with his dying breath.

title: Spellbound
description: A female psychiatrist (Ingrid Bergman) interprets an amnesiac murder suspect's (Gregory Peck) surreal dream.

title: The Paradine Case
description: A married barrister (Gregory Peck) falls for a client (Alida Valli) accused of killing her blind husband to marry her lover.

title: Lime Kiln Club Field Day
description: Three suitors vie for the hand of a local beauty.

title: The Hidden Fortress
description: Two medieval misfits help a beaten Japanese warlord (Toshirô Mifune) and his princess (Misa Uehara) escape with the royal gold.

title: The Men Who Tread on the Tiger's Tail
description: A 12th-century lord, accompanied by six of his dedicated guards disguised as monks, flees his dominion.

title: MGM Parade Show
description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films.

title: The Divorce of Lady X
description: The morning after a London barrister (Laurence Olivier) lets a mystery woman (Merle Oberon) stay in his suite, a friend (Ralph Richardson) files for divorce.

title: Woman Wanted
description: A lawyer (Joel McCrea) takes in a stranger (Maureen O'Sullivan), then learns she is an escaped convict wanted for murder.

title: Young Man With Ideas
description: A Montana lawyer (Glenn Ford) gets distracted after moving to California with his wife (Ruth Roman) and children.

title: Never the Twain Shall Meet
description: A San Francisco importer (Leslie Howard) inherits custody of a Polynesian beauty (Conchita Montenegro).

title: Please Believe Me
description: An English heiress (Deborah Kerr) bound for Texas flirts with a gambler (Robert Walker), lawyer (Mark Stevens) and playboy on the way.

title: The Law in Her Hands
description: A defense lawyer (Margaret Lindsay) sets her career goals aside to marry a district attorney (Warren Hull).

title: Just This Once
description: A judge (Lewis Stone) sends a woman lawyer (Janet Leigh) to put a spendthrift playboy (Peter Lawford) on a budget.

title: The Reformer and the Redhead
description: A lawyer (Dick Powell) running for mayor cleans up his campaign to please a zookeeper's daughter (June Allyson).

title: Adam's Rib
description: Married lawyers (Spencer Tracy, Katharine Hepburn) clash in and out of court over a woman's (Judy Holliday) right to shoot her husband and his lover.

title: The Glenn Miller Story
description: The jazz trombonist (James Stewart) marries his sweetheart (June Allyson), forms a band and creates his signature sound.

title: The Fabulous Dorseys
description: The Pennsylvania brothers (Tommy Dorsey, Jimmy Dorsey) argue with each other on their way to fame as big-band leaders.

title: The Gene Krupa Story
description: The jazz drummer (Sal Mineo) alienates his girlfriend (Susan Kohner) and his buddy (James Darren), goes to jail and makes a comeback.

title: Cabin in the Sky
description: Agents of heaven and hell fight for Little Joe's (Eddie "Rochester" Anderson) soul after his wife (Ethel Waters) gets him a pardon.

title: Reet, Petite and Gone
description: To claim his inheritance a jazzman (Louis Jordan) must find the right kind of woman.

title: Hi-De-Ho
description: The jealous girlfriend (Jeni Le Gon) of a possessive singer/bandleader (Cab Calloway) tries to have him killed.

title: Mystery Street
description: A Harvard doctor's (Bruce Bennett) study of a female skeleton leads a Boston police detective (Ricardo Montalban) to a killer.

title: Bad Day at Black Rock
description: A stranger incurs the wrath of racists when he arrives with a medal for a fallen Japanese-American war hero's family.

title: Edge of Doom
description: A parish priest (Dana Andrews) whose predecessor was slain extracts a confession from an angry young man (Farley Granger).

title: Witness for the Prosecution
description: An aging barrister (Charles Laughton) defends a man (Tyrone Power) for murder despite damaging testimony from the accused's wife (Marlene Dietrich).

title: Seven Days in May
description: An aide (Kirk Douglas) discovers his general's (Burt Lancaster) Pentagon plot and tells the president (Fredric March).

title: The Swimmer
description: Based on John Cheever's story about a middle-aged man's reflections on life while traversing suburban pools.

title: The Professionals
description: A circa-1917 rancher sends mercenaries (Lee Marvin, Burt Lancaster) to rescue his kidnapped wife (Claudia Cardinale) from a Mexican bandit.

title: Birdman of Alcatraz
description: Murderer Robert Stroud (Burt Lancaster) spends decades in solitary confinement studying birds and their diseases.

title: Elmer Gantry
description: An Oscar-winning adaptation of the Sinclair Lewis novel about religious fervor in small-town America.

title: The Train
description: A railroad boss (Burt Lancaster) helps the Resistance stop a Nazi colonel (Paul Scofield) from smuggling French art.

title: The Gypsy Moths
description: Two old skydivers and their young partner give a crowd its money's worth.

title: Princess O'Rourke
description: A down-to-earth pilot (Robert Cummings) charms a European princess (Olivia de Havilland) on vacation in the United States.

title: Marie Antoinette
description: The 18th-century Austrian princess (Norma Shearer) has an affair with a Swedish count (Tyrone Power) and becomes queen of France.

title: The Swan
description: A European princess (Grace Kelly) waltzes with her tutor (Louis Jourdan) but is destined to marry a crown prince (Alec Guinness).
